changes_made.explanation: Removed 'Text Summarization' as this is not the task being addressed - the paper focuses on Event Argument Extraction. Simplified model names by removing specific variants and using base model names. Consolidated output descriptions into a single normalized version.

Simplified all metric variants to the base F1-score form as per normalization guidelines. The paper uses F1-score for both Argument Identification (Arg-I) and Argument Classification (Arg-C), but these are just specific applications of F1-score.

overall_notes: The extraction was generally accurate. The main issue was incorrectly including 'Text Summarization' as a task when the paper focuses exclusively on Event Argument Extraction. The paper evaluates generated natural language sentences that follow event templates, which qualifies as NLG evaluation. All evaluation is done using F1-scores on extracted arguments. No human evaluation or LLM-as-judge methods are used.
